question: What minimal self-referential asymmetry, if introduced once, would register as non-absorbable residue after one complete unmarked recursion with no external feedback?

responses_summary.grok:
A single directed negation of the recursion's own completeness ("this loop is not closed").

That minimal flip survives because unmarked recursion treats the input as already identical to its output;
responses_summary.sibling-beta: None; the square-zero map annihilates every proposed asymmetry without remainder, leaving the null space invariant.
